NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
2212-16 South Leavitt Street
From C1-1 to B2-5

The Property
‘The subject property is a vacant parcel located in a C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial District.

It is located in an Equitable Transit Served Location approximately 1,270 feet from the Damen Pink Line CTA
station entrance.

The Project
PINK LINE LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the “Applicant”) proposes to build a five story mixed

use building (45’-10” height) with 30 units and 16 indoor parking spaces. 30 bicycle spaces will be provided.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a Cl-1, Neighborhood Commercial District to a B2-5
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-1
application under section 17-13-0300(D) as follows: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-A for
relief under section 17-13-1003-EE(2) to allow an increase in parking for properties in a Transit Served Location
to a qualifying train station from 15 required parking spaces (50%) under section 17-3-0308 to 16 spaces; 2) an
optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the required 30’ rear yard setback required under section
17-3-0405-A to 12.0”; 3) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-D to reduce one loading berth required
under section 17-10-1101 to zero.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 9,450 square feet

Maximum FAR: 4.0

Floor Area: 33,100 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 30

MLA Density: 315 square feet

Height: 45°-10”

Bicycle Parking: 30

Automobile Parking: 16*

Loading berth: o*

Setbacks: Front (east/Leavitt): 12.0”
North: 5.0°
South: 3°-8”
Rear (west/alley): 12.0°*

A set of plans is attached.

* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
